posts.title: New in the SmokeRoach Shop: SmokeRoach Airways Cabin Crew tee ✈️
posts.body: Pilot, navigator, security: Scott, Charlotte and Gunner are now on a T-shirt. The SmokeRoach Airways Cabin Crew tee is £25 on our SmokeRoach Shop.

posts.title: New video: The YouTube Mistake I Wish I Knew at the Start 😩
posts.body: A camera rammed full of half-finished videos, a cheap mic that kept cutting out, and the DJI Mic Mini 2 that finally sorted the sound. The lesson: you don't need loads of gear, just start.

posts.title: Nearly 500 subscribers 🎉
posts.body: The channel passed 495 subscribers this month. Massive thanks to everyone who's watched, commented and subscribed. Every single one counts.

posts.title: Next goal: 4,000 watch hours
posts.body: We're working towards 4,000 watch hours so the channel can be monetised. Watching the full videos genuinely helps us get there.
